title: Module manifest
description: Source directories, sibling module dependencies and compile classpath of one module of an analysed repository.

commit.description: Full SHA of the commit the module was read from.

sources.description: Source directories, relative to the root of the analysed repository, sorted. The model holds a copy of each under its source directory.

projectDeps.description: Paths of the other modules on the compile classpath, sorted.

jars.description: Jars on the compile classpath, in classpath order. Absolute paths point outside the analysed repository; relative paths name files of the repository, copied to the model like the sources.

resources.description: The configuration files (application.yaml, application.yml, application.properties) of the module's main resource directories, relative to the root of the analysed repository, sorted. The model holds a copy of each under its source directory. Absent where there are none, and from a model made by an earlier version of the tool.
